preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
Each test case must have a number of teams n between 2 and 100.

postconditions.expression: all(score == score for score in scores)
postconditions.description: All teams must have the same score after all games.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for result in results if result == 0) == min_ties
postconditions.description: The number of ties must be minimized.
The output must contain exactly n(n-1)/2 integers representing the results of the games.
